newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr/yr in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls yr/yr in Aug.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 2.3 percent year-on-year in August, the national statistics institute ISTAT said on Wednesday.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 76.6 (1988=100) in August, with month-on-month employment up 0.1 percent.
Hours worked per employee fell 5.4 percent year-on-year, which ISTAT said reflected one working day fewer in the month than in August 1995.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes fell 22.6 percent year-on-year.
In the services sector, the employment index stood at 91.3 (1992=100), a fall of 0.9 percent year-on-year and of 0.1 percent compared with July.
